en: a large, strong, wild animal with thick fur
ex: Erin knew there were bears in the woods.

en: an animal that has wings and feathers, and is usually able to fly
ex: This animal was a bird but it couldn’t fly.

en: a small animal with fur, four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet
ex: The Europeans took animals such as dogs and cats to the island.

en: an intelligent animal that lives in the sea, breathes air, and looks like a large, smooth, grey fish
ex: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.

en: an animal with fur, four legs and a tail, especially kept by people as a pet
ex: The Europeans took animals such as dogs and cats to the island.

en: a very large, grey animal with big ears and a very long nose
ex: We saw elephants, tigers, and snakes at the zoo.

zh: 大猩猩；（非正式，常含贬义）高大强壮、凶悍的人，常指保镖或打手，也指粗壮笨拙的人
en: a big, black, hairy animal, like a large monkey
ex: There's a gorilla at the zoo.

en: a large animal with four legs, which people ride on
ex: It was very near to an eight-year-old boy who was on his horse.

en: a large wild cat that has yellow fur with black lines on it
ex: We saw elephants, tigers, and snakes at the zoo.

en: a small animal with fur and long ears that lives in a hole in the ground
ex: She has a pet rabbit.

en: a farm animal whose skin is covered with wool
ex: This cheese is made from sheep's milk.

en: a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground
ex: We saw elephants, tigers, and snakes at the zoo.

zh: 休息一下：停下正在做的事情，暂时休息一下。
en: to stop an activity for a short time, usually in order to rest or eat
ex: I always take a break when I study.

zh: 玩得开心：指在某个活动或场合中享受快乐和愉悦的时光。
en: to enjoy yourself
ex: I have a good time at the weekend.

zh: 犯错误：在做某事时出现错误或不正确的行为。
en: to do something that is not correct
ex: I don't often make mistakes with my homework.

zh: 大谈特谈或抱怨：对某事大谈特谈或抱怨。
en: to make a sound, often a loud, unpleasant sound
ex: The bear made a terrible noise.

zh: 淋浴：在浴室内用水淋浴来清洗身体。
en: to wash your body while standing under a flow of water
ex: I have a shower in the morning.

zh: 变得生气，发怒：感到愤怒或不满（常与 at/with 连用，表示对某人或某事生气）。
en: to start to have a strong feeling against someone who has behaved badly or something you do not like
ex: I get angry when my brother takes my things.

en: to leave a place
ex: After a while, the bear went away.

zh: 变得兴奋：感到非常高兴和热情。
en: to start to feel happy and enthusiastic
ex: I always get excited when I go on holiday.

zh: 做作业，做家庭作业；做足功课（事先认真研究某个主题或情况，以便能够妥善处理）。
en: to do work your teacher has given you to do at home
ex: I didn't do my homework last night.

zh: 度假：离开日常生活去休闲或旅游的行为。
en: to go to a place away from where you live, for pleasure
ex: My family didn't go on holiday last year.

zh: 拍照：使用相机或手机等设备拍摄照片。
en: to produce pictures with a camera
ex: Last week I took a lot of photos with my phone.

zh: 采取行动：为了帮助情况而采取某种行动。
en: to take an action
ex: We need to do something to help him!

en: very attractive
ex: Erin thought Tonk was a beautiful horse.

en: not interesting or exciting
ex: a boring TV programme

en: not dirty
ex: a clean white shirt

zh: able to learn and understand things quickly and easily
en: able to learn and understand things quickly and easily
ex: Both children were clever.

en: If someone or something is dangerous, they could harm you.
ex: Sometimes snakes are dangerous.

en: not clean
ex: a dirty car

zh: 可怕的，令人恐惧的；糟糕的，讨厌的；不友好的
en: very unpleasant or bad
ex: Dan! Don’t be horrible!

zh: adj. 有趣的，有吸引力的
en: Someone or something that is interesting keeps your attention because they are unusual, exciting, or have a lot of ideas.
ex: I talked to my friends but they didn’t say anything interesting.

en: pleasant or enjoyable
ex: a lovely meal/evening

en: not in danger or likely to be harmed
ex: In some cities you don't feel safe going out alone at night.

zh: 笨的，傻的，脑子不好使的；欠考虑的，糊涂的；（用以加强语气）讨厌的，恼人的，无聊的；（因醉、累等）不省人事的，神思恍惚的
en: silly or not intelligent
ex: How could you be so stupid?

en: unpleasant to look at
ex: a big, fat, ugly spider
